name: Clans of London
summary:
Clans of London is a fast-paced collectible card game set in the World of Darkness, drawing on the themes and clans of Vampire: The Masquerade. Players build decks from competing vampire factions and face off in short, tactical matches that take place across key London locations.

Each match features a central “King of the Hill” objective where players compete for influence, while different in-game locations provide unique modifiers that shape deck-building choices and strategic approaches. These location effects introduce variety across games without altering the board state mid-match.

Clans of London combines dark urban fantasy with strategic card play, emphasising quick matches, variable objectives, and deck-building across multiple vampire clans.
